title: CLN: restore list annotation in _get_dst_hours (GH#57154)
body:
closes #57154

GH-57144 removed the `list trans_grp` annotation because numpy#25570 made `np.array_split` return a tuple, leaving a TODO to use `tuple` once numpy>=2 is the minimum. numpy reverted that change in numpy#25800 before 2.0.0 was released, so `array_split` returns a list on every supported numpy. This restores the original `list` annotation and drops the stale TODO.

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), used to investigate the numpy history and make the change.
